leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize two pointers at opposite ends of a sorted array
Manipulate pointer positions based on sum comparisons with target values
Construct a while loop that terminates when the target sum is found
Apply the two-pointer technique to solve the Two Sum II problem
Return the 1-indexed positions of the two numbers that sum to the target
Control loop execution to prevent out-of-bounds pointer movement
Integrate pointer movement logic with sum calculation in a complete solution
